# Coding AI Prompt — Complete Landing Page (Apple Style, Fictional Brand)

Build a complete, production-quality landing page for a **fictional brand** (invent an original name, logo mark, product, and copy — never use "Apple", the Apple logo, or any Apple product/trademark names). Apply the visual language described below. Deliver separate `index.html`, `style.css`, and `script.js` files. No inline `style="..."` attributes; all styling lives in `style.css` via class/ID selectors. Enforce one consistent naming convention (BEM) throughout.

## 1. Theme Tokens & CSS Variables

Define in `:root` (light fallback) and under `.dark` / `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`:

**Colors**
- `--color-polar-white: #f5f5f7`
- `--color-absolute-black: #000000`
- `--color-carbon: #111111`
- `--color-white: #ffffff`
- `--color-graphite: #1d1d1f`
- `--color-steel: #86868b`
- `--color-divider-gray: #6e6e73`
- `--color-control-charcoal: #333336`
- `--color-glyph-silver: #cccccc`
- `--color-battery-green: #00d959`
- `--color-link-blue: #0066cc`
- `--color-purchase-blue: #0071e3`
- `--color-launch-orange: #ff791b`
- `--color-new-orange: #b64400`
- `--color-ember-black: #311400`

**Typography tokens** (map to Google Font Inter as substitute for SF Pro Display/Text):
- `--font-sf-pro-display` / `--font-sf-pro-text` → `'Inter', sans-serif` (load via Google Fonts `<link>`)
- Type scale tokens: `--text-micro-label`, `--text-global-nav`, `--text-button-label`, `--text-body`, `--text-body-strong`, `--text-product-label`, `--text-section-heading`, `--text-metric-heading`, `--text-display-metric`, `--text-hero-display`, `--text-accent-display` with exact sizes/weights/line-heights/letter-spacing from spec.

**Spacing & shapes**
- Spacing scale `--spacing-4` … `--spacing-210` per table.
- `--radius-sm: 5px`, `--radius-md: 10px`, `--radius-lg: 28px`, `--radius-pill: 980px`, `--radius-chip: 36px`.
- `--shadow-sm/md` defined but unused on cards (no shadows on 28px tiles).
- `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.

**Dark mode (mandatory):** Provide tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark` class. Persist user choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`; include a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`. Background/text variables switch seamlessly without HTML restructuring. Contrast pairing: light bg → dark text, dark bg → light text in both themes.

**Light mode background:** Carbon `#111111` default canvas (dark theme). Where white/near-white needed use `#fefefe`. Do not default to pure white for page background.

## 2. Layout & Typography Rules

- Flexbox for all layout; every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless justified exception.
- Mobile-first, responsive, no horizontal scroll.
- Tailwind CSS via CDN or clean custom CSS with `@layer`/`@apply`; utility classes map to CSS variables or reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).
- Google Fonts mandatory for text (Inter) and Google Material Symbols for icons. No inline SVGs or local icon files.
- Smooth CSS transitions on all state changes; respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## 3. Page Structure & Sections

Build these sections in order:

1. **Global Commerce Navigation** — 44px bar, Carbon `#111111`, compact SF Pro Text 12px/12px weight 400 labels in `rgba(255,255,255,0.8)`, Glyph Silver `#cccccc` utility glyphs, 4px gaps. Apple mark replaced by fictional brand mark (CSS/SVG-free — use a text wordmark or Material Symbol). Keep nav visually smaller than product content.

2. **Product Local Navigation** — 52px Carbon bar beneath global nav. Product title SF Pro Text 17px/21px weight 600 in `rgba(255,255,255,0.8)`; supporting links 12px/12px; fine Polar White active underline.

3. **Hero** — Absolute Black `#000000` stage. Small product lockup, large all-caps SF Pro Display 64px/68px weight 600 Polar White headline with `-0.576px` tracking, floating watch/product render (use a placeholder image URL or CSS shape — no real Apple imagery), compact centered purchase stack: Purchase Blue `#0071e3` 980px-radius Buy pill above Polar White SF Pro Text 14px/18px weight 600 pricing + finance line.

4. **Features** — 3 cards. Carbon `#111111` section with left-aligned Polar White SF Pro Display heading, then 28px-radius black media tiles (no shadow). One tile: black-and-white athletic photo with overlaid Polar White SF Pro Text 17px/25px copy and Battery Green `#00d959` metric emphasis. Use Dark Selector Chips (rgba(66,66,69,0.72) fill, 36px radius) where selectors appear.

5. **How It Works** — 3 steps. Carbon bands, oversized section headings, close-look module: left stack of Dark Selector Chips beside oversized cropped product render; Polar White SF Pro Display headings.

6. **Testimonials** — Pale White `#ffffff` 28px-radius information tiles with Graphite `#1d1d1f` SF Pro Text content, Link Blue `#0066cc` text-only reference links, no shadows. Deliberate inversion from dark tiles.

7. **Pricing** — 3 tiers. Use Purchase Blue pill buttons for CTAs, White Information Tile style for cards, Steel `#86868b` for muted feature lists.

8. **FAQ** — Feature Accordion Rows: Control Charcoal `#333336` pills, 36px radius, `rgba(255,255,255,0.8)` text, circular plus glyph prepended; selected row brighter gray fill, same geometry.

9. **Final CTA** — centered purchase affordance on Carbon/Absolute Black, Purchase Blue pill + pricing.

10. **Footer** — Polar Footer Band `#f5f5f7` with Graphite text, secondary links, Link Blue references.

## 4. Component State Requirements

- **Buttons:** default (flex, align-items center, justify-content center, gap 0.5rem, min 44x44px), hover (brightness/shadow, cursor pointer), focus (distinct ring via CSS vars), active (scale 0.97), loading (disabled, CSS spinner, no dimension distortion), disabled (opacity 0.5, greyscale, not-allowed), success/error (via `--text-success`/`--text-error`).
- **Cards:** default (flex, subtle borders, elevation via vars), hover (translateY(-2px)), focus-within (border highlight), loading skeleton (shimmer CSS), empty state (Google Icon + guidance text).
- **Forms/Inputs:** empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border/icon), invalid (error border, red text, error icon), disabled, read-only. Flex container wrapping label, input, error feedback.
- **Modal:** opening/open/loading/success-error/closing animated via CSS; centered flex, backdrop, Google Icon close button, Esc/overlay close, focus trap.

## 5. Additional Rules

- Availability Badge: Launch Orange `#ff791b` (future) or New Orange `#b64400` (newness) text; Ember Black `#311400` surface when colored badge needed; SF Pro Text 12px/16px weight 600.
- Pill Search Input: `rgba(255,255,255,0.04)` fill, Polar White text, 1px Divider Gray border, 980px radius, 24px left / 45px right padding.
- Technical Reference Link: Link Blue `#0066cc` unfilled text links only.
- No gradients behind hero hardware; stage stays `#000000`. No drop shadows on 28px tiles. No rectangular 4px/8px button corners. Purchase Blue only on compact filled Buy/Learn-more pills. Battery Green only for battery/performance metrics. Global nav 44px with 12px labels.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast both themes, semantic HTML5, ARIA roles/labels, logical focus order, full keyboard operability, `aria-live` for dynamic feedback. Never rely solely on color for state.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.
- No lorem-ipsum where real copy supplied; placeholders only where genuinely unspecified. Invent fictional brand copy.
- Do not use real brand name/logo/trademarks/product names anywhere.

## 6. Deliverables

- `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. Single deferred entry-point reference in HTML.
- BEM naming throughout. No inline scripts beyond deferred reference.

Output only the finished prompt. No preamble or closing commentary.
